column8: ∀ {c : UInt8} {n : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val c = Option.some n → n < 64 ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char n = c
∀ (bytes : List UInt8), bytes.length % 3 = 0 → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Decode (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Encode bytes) = Option.some bytes
∀ {text bytes : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Decode text = Option.some bytes → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Encode bytes = text
∀ {c₀ c₁ c₂ : UInt8} {bytes : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.decodeFinal c₀ c₁ c₂ = Option.some bytes → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode bytes = [c₀, c₁, c₂, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.pad]
∀ (bytes : List UInt8), Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.decode (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode bytes) = Option.some bytes
∀ (front back : List UInt8), front.length % 3 = 0 → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode (front ++ back) = Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode front ++ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode back
∀ {text bytes : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.decode text = Option.some bytes → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode bytes = text
∀ (bytes : List UInt8), bytes.length % 3 = 0 → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode bytes = Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Encode bytes

∀ (b₀ b₁ b₂ : UInt8), Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char (b₀.toNat / 4)) = Option.some (b₀.toNat / 4) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char (b₀.toNat % 4 * 16 + b₁.toNat / 16)) = Option.some (b₀.toNat % 4 * 16 + b₁.toNat / 16) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char (b₁.toNat % 16 * 4 + b₂.toNat / 64)) = Option.some (b₁.toNat % 16 * 4 + b₂.toNat / 64) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val (Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char (b₂.toNat % 64)) = Option.some (b₂.toNat % 64) ∧ UInt8.ofNat (b₀.toNat / 4 * 4 + (b₀.toNat % 4 * 16 + b₁.toNat / 16) / 16) = b₀ ∧ UInt8.ofNat ((b₀.toNat % 4 * 16 + b₁.toNat / 16) % 16 * 16 + (b₁.toNat % 16 * 4 + b₂.toNat / 64) / 4) = b₁ ∧ UInt8.ofNat ((b₁.toNat % 16 * 4 + b₂.toNat / 64) % 4 * 64 + b₂.toNat % 64) = b₂

∀ {c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : UInt8} {s₀ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val c₀ = Option.some s₀ → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val c₁ = Option.some s₁ → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val c₂ = Option.some s₂ → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Val c₃ = Option.some s₃ → Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char ((UInt8.ofNat (s₀ * 4 + s₁ / 16)).toNat / 4) = c₀ ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char ((UInt8.ofNat (s₀ * 4 + s₁ / 16)).toNat % 4 * 16 + (UInt8.ofNat (s₁ % 16 * 16 + s₂ / 4)).toNat / 16) = c₁ ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char ((UInt8.ofNat (s₁ % 16 * 16 + s₂ / 4)).toNat % 16 * 4 + (UInt8.ofNat (s₂ % 4 * 64 + s₃)).toNat / 64) = c₂ ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.b64Char ((UInt8.ofNat (s₂ % 4 * 64 + s₃)).toNat % 64) = c₃

Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "".toUTF8.toList = "".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "f".toUTF8.toList = "Zg==".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "fo".toUTF8.toList = "Zm8=".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "foo".toUTF8.toList = "Zm9v".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "foob".toUTF8.toList = "Zm9vYg==".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "fooba".toUTF8.toList = "Zm9vYmE=".toUTF8.toList ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.Base64.encode "foobar".toUTF8.toList = "Zm9vYmFy".toUTF8.toList
